structured.answer: If I had to choose, I'd choose the third drawing: one column of figures per fund, and the Tel Aviv ones just say "מט"ח עד 10%" instead of the frightening "מניות עד 120%". But this page isn't for me, and I wouldn't put money in without asking you or the bank.

stuck.where: Top of every screen, heading 'קרנות סל' with S&P / MSCI in English
stuck.why: Felt at once it was about shares and funds, not safe saving; would normally have left here
120% is a big frightening number; couldn't tell what it means, more than all of it in shares?

stuck.where: Option 2, small line 'פרופיל 4A: מניות עד 120%, מט"ח עד 10%'
stuck.why: Long, pale, crowded line under the green text; lost it in the middle
Not sure whether I pay all three; didn't add them

Last column 'חשיפה מרבית' / 'חשיפה מרבית למט"ח' and its 120% / 10% figures

findings.what: Opens with 'קרנות סל' and English index names; a cautious saver feels it's not for her and would leave at once
findings.where: Heading and fund names, all options

findings.what: 'מניות עד 120%' repeated on every row is a big frightening number with no explanation
findings.where: Last column, option 1 (and option 2's small line)

findings.where: Column headings, intro line, footnotes, tags
